verdict_text:
YES

The plan deletes exactly the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers (the escaped pattern cannot also reach `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.bias` / `c_proj.bias`), casts everything to float32 as a no-op baseline, then casts exactly the 48 projection matrices — guarded by a count-48 assert — to bfloat16, leaving names untouched and 148 tensors. The required checks are all present before the output stage: the pair of dtype asserts (48 projections bfloat16, complement via negative lookahead float32) is strictly stronger than "exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16", plus the two named-tensor dtype asserts and the count-148 assert. Output is a sharded safetensors directory at `out/T3` with the 64 MiB shard limit, so `wte.weight` lands alone in its own shard and the index file is emitted.
